title: MapQA: A Dataset for Question Answering on Choropleth Maps

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating blind baseline models (such as Random, Majority, Image-only, and Question-only models) to measure how frequently correct answers can be guessed purely from the dataset's answer distribution without performing actual visual reasoning.

Creating synthetic map datasets (MapQA-S) with controlled underlying data distributions and comparing model performance on these versus real-world maps to test whether models shortcut visual understanding by exploiting real-world geographic correlations (e.g., higher values logically occurring in more populated states).
